name: Nacdac Infrastructure Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2012, NACDAC Infrastructure 
 Ltd is in the business of construction and infra structure development[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) NACDACIL is a construction company specializing in a comprehensive range of civil and structural services 
b) Its core offerings encompass construction of multi-story buildings, electrical works (both Low Tension & High-Tension), pre-fabricated steel structure works, bridges (including FOBs and ROBs) and associated civil and structural works, etc. for government agencies, and pvt. corporations
c) It is registered as class A contractor with Uttarakhand Peyjal Sansadhan Vikas Evum Nirman Nigam, Uttarakhand.
d) Company also undertakes sub-contracting projects from third-party major infrastructure, construction entities, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 69.4 to 95.0 days.
